title: Convenient Respawn
description: Player die will turn into gamemode spectate for X sec and respawn near death location
body:
📦 Convenient Respawn
Convenient Respawn is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that changes the way players come back to life after dying. Instead of immediately respawning, players first enter spectator mode for a short time, then respawn automatically at a nearby location.

🔧 What It Does
When a player dies, they are placed into gamemode spectator.

After a configurable delay, they are automatically respawned at a random nearby location within a set radius.

🎯 Why Use This Plugin?
Adds immersion and realism for survival, PvP, or adventure servers.

Prevents spawn camping or instant respawn abuse.

Lets players observe their surroundings before re-entering the game.

📘 Features
⏱ Configurable respawn delay (in seconds).

📍 Respawns the player within a customizable radius around their death point.

✅ Lightweight and easy to install – no database or dependencies required.

🛡 Compatible with Paper and Spigot.

🌐 Language Support
The plugin is documented in English. Config files are simple and easy to edit.
